fields.value: Let experiment declarations select a run's stored output files as job inputs

Experiment state lists a training run's checkpoints but nothing else it stored, so training_jobs(state) cannot hand a producer run's output file (such as an immutable snapshot pack) to a later job. Etude already records each run's stored membership (out.json: key, SHA256, size, published after the files) and already delivers and verifies Inputs.

Outcome: each run summary in ExperimentState exposes its stored out membership (e.g. run.out, with a way to select members by pattern), and a member makes an Input (e.g. member.input(name)) carrying run, key, digest, size and locator, delivered and verified as checkpoint inputs are. Only members listed in stored membership are visible, so a declaration never sees undelivered bytes. Reading state stays a read: no extra provider calls; storage reads counted in a test.

Jack Heart, 2026-11-14, asked whether to expose those output members through ExperimentState so jobs can select them as inputs, as an Etude change before 0.4.1: "yes". Driven by Manabot MTG-357 (belief fits selecting snapshot packs from a player run). Independent of EXP-73 and EXP-75; based on main. No rental, no release; do not merge or arm merge.
